integrity: The analytic argument proves the infinite theorem. A separate finite diagnostic enumerated 33,856 graphs and made 39,788 checks; this is corroborative rather than an infinite certificate. No independent validation or third-party certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Non-induced tree subgraphs and isolate falling factorials only; all formulas require the stated admissibility interval. The phase profile concerns normalized mixed moments and covariance signs; raw covariance magnitude depends on edge density. Two historical full texts were inaccessible, so absolute historical priority is not certified.
title: Universal macroscopic-tree covariance threshold in fixed-edge random graphs
